About Slime Stretch

Slime Stretch is a small slime shop run by a young maker who loves everything stretchy, squishy, and sparkly. Each slime is made in small batches, tested for the perfect stretch, and packed by hand.

New colours and textures are always in the works — check back for fresh drops.

Slime care tips

  • Wash your hands before and after playing — it keeps slime clean and unstuck.
  • Always store slime in its jar with the lid on tight so it doesn't dry out.
  • Play on a clean, hard surface — slime and carpet are not friends.
  • If slime gets stiff, warm it in your hands or knead in a drop of warm water.
  • Slime is for playing, not eating — keep it away from little kids and pets.
